overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for long-running campaigns and optimizing the Monte Carlo convergence logic for ultra-endgame scenarios. This batch focuses on reducing memory footprint and ensuring 100% reproducibility in 5,500+ tick simulations.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Hasher
acceptance_criteria: Hasher produces identical uint64_t for identical input sequences across 10,000 Monte Carlo runs.
Zero dynamic allocations during hashing phase.
Compile-time evaluation supported for static initial states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save/load consistency and enables rapid state comparison for debugging.

tasks.title: Optimize Footstep Log Compression for 5k+ Ticks
acceptance_criteria: Memory footprint reduced by 60% compared to previous std::vector implementation.
Linear access time O(1) for sequential playback.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save file loading and reduced memory usage for long campaigns.

tasks.title: Cache Monte Carlo Convergence Results
acceptance_criteria: Cache hit rate > 85% for repetitive endgame scenarios.
No invalidation issues with deterministic hashing.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instantaneous response for repeated simulation steps in endgame.
